cause: Readiness helpers were promoted for orchestration callers but cmd_create retained a legacy compatibility boundary and never invoked them.
prevention: When a host adopts a canonical taskset or complete unit, require typed T0 validation and readiness refusal before security checks, Compound lookup, claim files, events, worktrees, or Git effects; keep legacy identity-only compatibility explicit and tested.
summary: Autofolio attempt 2 showed that taskset and wave refused unsafe work while direct task_claim_dispatcher create still persisted claims without strict T0 and readiness preflight.
title: Keep claim readiness identical across direct, taskset, and wave entry points
